image_content_row_group.add_content:
Sales channels

Natively integrated with the most important channels and platforms (Amazon, Shopify, Walmart, eBay, etc.) and able to integrate through middlewares with any other system.

Inventory

Seamlessly connected to leading fulfillment platforms like Amazon FBA, Walmart WFS, and 3PL systems, with the flexibility to integrate any other system through middlewares. Stay in control of your inventory, no matter where it lives.

Google Sheets

Flieber is able to consume sales, inventory, and PO/TO data directly from Google Sheets, making it very easy to automate sources of data that aren’t connected to systems.

params.add_content:
Simple frontend, advanced backend

Flieber provides a clear, user-friendly interface that gives you complete visibility over your sales and inventory with real-time accuracy. On the backend, it uses advanced data contextualization, inventory consumption calculations, and supply chain mapping to deliver the most accurate forecasting and recommendations possible.

three_column_group.add_text: Connect your data sources, such as sales channels, Amazon FBA, and 3PLs, and auto-map your integrations.
Configure the most important parameters, such as safety stock levels, target days of coverage, MOQs, etc., and watch accurate forecasting and restocking suggestions start flowing in.
Go live! Start saving time and cutting costs right away. Set up can take as little as 20 minutes to complete.
